description.summary: panel settings for applets embedded in a panel

protocol.description: This protocol allows an applet to learn about the panel it is embedded in and to be notified when the settings of that panel change at runtime.

interface.name: cosmic_panel_applet_manager_v1
interface.description: Manager for creating objects that expose the settings of the panel an applet is embedded in.

request.name: get_panel_applet

description.summary: get the settings of the panel hosting the calling applet

request.description:
Create a new cosmic_panel_applet_v1 object for the calling client and send it the current settings of the panel the applet is embedded in.
If the calling client already has a cosmic_panel_applet_v1 object, the panel_applet_exists protocol error will be raised.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Informs the panel that the client will no longer use this manager. Objects created by this manager remain valid until they are destroyed.

entry.name: panel_applet_exists
entry.summary: the client already has a cosmic_panel_applet_v1 object

interface.name: cosmic_panel_applet_v1

description.summary: settings of the panel an applet is embedded in

interface.description: Provides the settings of the panel this applet is embedded in, so that the applet can lay itself out and size its window for that panel.

event.name: panel_name
event.description: Name of the panel profile this applet is embedded in, e.g. "Panel" or "Dock".

event.name: output

description.summary: name of the output the panel is displayed on

event.description: Name of the output the panel is displayed on, or an empty string if the name of the output is not known.

event.name: anchor

description.summary: edge of the output the panel is anchored to

event.description: Edge of the output the panel is anchored to. The anchor also determines the orientation of the panel and of the applets in it: a panel anchored to the left or right edge is vertical, a panel anchored to the top or bottom edge is horizontal.

event.name: applet_size

description.summary: size of the applet in the panel

event.description:
Size the applet should use inside the panel.
If size is applet_size.custom, the custom argument contains the configured size in logical pixels; it is zero otherwise.

event.name: spacing
event.description: Spacing in logical pixels the panel leaves between the applets of a section of the panel.

event.name: background
event.description:
Background of the panel the applet is embedded in.
The red, green and blue arguments are in the range [0, 1] and are only meaningful if background is background.color; they are zero otherwise. The color space is sRGB.

arg.name: red
arg.summary: red channel of a custom background

arg.name: green
arg.summary: green channel of a custom background

arg.name: blue
arg.summary: blue channel of a custom background

event.name: padding_overlap

description.summary: ratio of applet padding overlapping the panel

event.description: Ratio in the range [0, 1] of the padding of an applet that overlaps the panel background. Applets can use this to size their clickable area.

event.name: done

description.summary: end of a batch of settings

event.description: This event is sent after the panel has sent all the settings when this object is created, and only the settings that changed afterwards. An applet applies the settings when it receives this event, so that a batch of events is applied as one update.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Informs the panel that the client is no longer interested in the settings of its panel. The panel will not send any further events to this object.

entry.name: left
entry.summary: the panel is anchored to the left edge

entry.name: right
entry.summary: the panel is anchored to the right edge

entry.name: top
entry.summary: the panel is anchored to the top edge

entry.name: bottom
entry.summary: the panel is anchored to the bottom edge

entry.name: custom
entry.summary: custom applet size, see the custom argument

entry.name: theme_default
entry.summary: the default background of the theme

entry.name: color
entry.summary: a custom solid color, see the color arguments
